title: Readable entity names
responsibility: Keeps canonical recorded code names consistent across catalogs, related units and detail pages; derives readable route screen labels separately.

inputs.name: explorerName.unit
inputs.description: A Harness unit's required ID, kind, and title, with optional owned source paths and symbols. Its kind, title, and owned code metadata select the naming rule; the final dotted ID segment is a fallback.

inputs.name: explorerAppRoute.unit
inputs.description: A unit's kind, title, and owned source metadata used to resolve an application route. Only page and layout kinds can return an address, and a non-slash title needs an owned /routes/.../+page.svelte source.

outputs.name: explorerName
outputs.description: Returns a readable string, preserving slash-prefixed endpoint/API titles and otherwise preferring owned code identity, an eligible written title, route-screen words, then the final dotted ID segment. Known initials are uppercased, and no remaining name words yields 'Unnamed'.

outputs.name: explorerAppRoute
outputs.description: For a page or layout, returns a slash-prefixed title unchanged or derives the address from the first owned +page.svelte file under /routes/; returns null otherwise. A root route file maps to /.
